body:
Date repair workers cleared active hints after changing an exact year to a one-sided bound, causing otherwise valid chronology proposals to fail production validation. Clarify the producer contract with qualified hint text, a check of all retained claims, and hints-last ordering after claim edits and reception additions. Validators, schemas, ownership and spending limits are unchanged.

Validation: 225 workflow/worker/campaign tests and 36 ownership tests passed. Actual native first-send capture passes the existing 57,344-byte guard for all six retained packets; the largest remaining message is 57,066 bytes, including the new clause. Independent reviewer bc-74dd257a-d700-4154-863d-950a6fc95d38 approved exact commit 33bf1df1e0c2a9b6d5db914de79ec6e20c374eb1 with no findings after checking that capture. The initial overflow finding double-counted the added clause; its original report and re-check are preserved.
